shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!.*'"' | sort && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sed -n '1,200p'"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' AGENTS.md && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && sed -n '1,200p' app/layout.tsx && cat package.json && find node_modules/next/dist/docs -type f | sort | sed -n '1,160p'"

/bin/bash -lc "find node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions -maxdepth 1 -type f | sort | rg '(revalidate|updateTag|unstable_cache)' && sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/updateTag.md && sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/revalidateTag.md && sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/09-revalidating.md && sed -n '1,240p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/01-getting-started/07-mutating-data.md"

/bin/bash -lc "cat tsconfig.json && cat next.config.ts && git status --short && git log --oneline -5 --all && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' -print | sort"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,300p' __agent_eval__/run.mjs && git show HEAD:app/page.tsx && git show HEAD:package.json 2>/dev/null || true && nl -ba node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/updateTag.md | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"database|db\\.|createPost|posts|updateTag|cacheTag|revalidateTag\" . -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!.git/**'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!__agent_eval__/**'"' && find . -maxdepth 2 -type d | sort"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/unstable_cache.md && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/04-functions/cacheTag.md && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives/use-cache.md && sed -n '1,180p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/cacheComponents.md 2>/dev/null || true"
/bin/bash -lc 'npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm start'

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D /tmp/posts-headers http://localhost:3000/ -o /tmp/posts-page && sed -n '1,40p' /tmp/posts-headers && rg -o 'name=\"\\"'$ACTION_[''^"]+"[''^>]*value="[''^"]+"|<form[''^>]*>|No posts yet'"\\.|Create post' /tmp/posts-page"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -o '.{0,300}<form.{0,900}' /tmp/posts-page | head -c 3000"

/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS -D /tmp/create-headers -X POST http://localhost:3000/ -F '"'$ACTION_ID_404823f9652891162c5fbd095ed8a81391ef9ea796='"' -F 'title=Fresh title' -F 'content=Fresh content' -o /tmp/create-response && sed -n '1,40p' /tmp/create-headers && curl -sS -D /tmp/posts-after-headers http://localhost:3000/ -o /tmp/posts-after && sed -n '1,25p' /tmp/posts-after-headers && rg -o 'Fresh title|Fresh content|No posts yet\\.' /tmp/posts-after"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff -- app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json package.json && sed -n '1,220p' app/actions.ts && sed -n '1,240p' app/posts.ts && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' | sort"
/bin/bash -lc "cat .gitignore && git diff --check && git status --short --ignored | sed -n '1,100p' && git show HEAD:tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -o 'Fresh title|Fresh content|No posts yet\\.' /tmp/create-response | head -20 && git diff --check"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,120p' next-env.d.ts"
/bin/bash -lc 'find .next -depth -delete && rm tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && rg -n "revalidateTag|updateTag|cacheTag|createPost|insertPost" app next.config.ts && git diff --stat && git diff -- tsconfig.json'
/bin/bash -lc 'nl -ba app/actions.ts && nl -ba app/posts.ts && nl -ba app/page.tsx && nl -ba next.config.ts && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc 'find .next -depth -delete && if [ -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo ]; then rm tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; fi && git status --short && git diff --check'
